newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian stocks crawl sideways, await data.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian stocks crawl sideways, await data.

text.p: Norwegian shares prices traded mainly flat on Monday with investors cautious ahead of domestic economic data due over the coming two weeks, brokers said.
An expected 25 basis points rise in U.S. interest rates at a meeting of ther Federal Reserve on Tuesday had been largely discounted by the market, they said.
The Total share index closed off 0.21 percent at 840.82 points in mediocre turnover of just over 500 million crowns.
"We are still moving sideways," said one dealer. "You won't see much happening here until the Central Bank inflation outlook on Wednesday and the budget next week."
Norway's Central Bank will release a quarterly inflation forecast on Wednesday. The government is due to present its new budget for 1997 to parliament on October 4.
Broker said Norsk Hydro and Elkem were negatively impacted by a slump in aluminium prices on the London Metal Exchansge to 2 1/4-year lows to below $1,400 per tonne.
Norsk Hydro fell to a low at 302.50 crowns before recovering to close 0.50 crowns off at 304. Elkem gave up one crown to 91.50 crowns.
